role_sought: FPÖ party leadership in the federal election
detail: Party result under Haider, not a personal election as chancellor or a personal preference-vote percentage. FPÖ narrowly exceeded ÖVP in votes; both won 52 seats.

role_sought: Lead candidate of BZÖ – Liste Jörg Haider
detail: National party-list result. It does not establish that Haider took a National Council seat after this election; his official mandate record ends in 1999.
